environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on EKS (Kubernetes 1.28) with HMAC_SECRET injected via Kubernetes Secret mounted as environment variable. No HSM integration configured (HSM_ENDPOINT not set). Service exposed via internal ALB with no rate limiting. Pod runs with default network policy allowing unrestricted egress/ingress within the VPC. Node.js 20 runtime with default event loop, single-threaded execution providing consistent timing measurements.

config.network: Internal ALB, no rate limiting, no WAF
